description: Elections Commission - V. P. Lakshman and H. G. Sumithlal of the Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - P. A. Indunil of the Millaniya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices declaring that members of local authorities (Pradeshiya Sabhas) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, specifically addressing the status of elected members in local government bodies under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
